basic_info.description: Fully Detached with PANO view! This Mid-Century Modern Gem takes in Panoramic views of Mount Davidson, Twin Peaks, Downtown Skyline and Mount Diablo! Nestled in the highly desired Crocker Amazon neighborhood, this light-filled 3BD/2BA home showcases clean lines, large picture windows, and an airy open-concept layout designed to embrace both style and function. The upper level features 3 bedrooms and a living room with refinished flooring and new chandelier. The updated kitchen boasts granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinet space, flowing seamlessly into a dining area framed by iconic city views. Downstairs offers a flexible bonus room - perfect as a family room, guest suite, or office. Rarely available two-car side-by-side garage, offers convenience and extra storage space. The private backyard is a true retreat with a view deck and low-maintenance landscaping, plus a beautiful Maple tree and a Pipa Fruit tree, ideal for entertaining or quiet reflection. Move-in ready with thoughtful upgrades, this is mid-century living at its finest! 3D Walk trough: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=wqQoZTsLCVA
